description: Polyphonic envelope follower and pitch detector, measuring the loudness and the pitch of a single tone in the incoming audio by counting samples between zero crossings

params.text: Sets the input level above which pitch detection runs, from -94dB to 0dB with a default of -30dB, so that quiet noise between notes is ignored
Attenuates and inverts the threshold CV
Sets how fast the reported pitch is slewed; slow settings glide between notes but hold steady, fast settings jump to new notes and waver more
Attenuates and inverts the speed CV
Sets the centre frequency of the bandpass prefilter that narrows the detector onto the wanted range of notes, spanning 5 octaves either side of C5 at 523.251Hz
Attenuates and inverts the centre frequency CV
Sets the resonance of the bandpass prefilter; higher values squeeze the passband in, and too much causes false detection near the centre frequency
Attenuates and inverts the resonance CV
Scales the ENV output by a factor of 0 to 16, marked from minus infinity dB to +24dB, with 0dB leaving it unchanged
Attenuates and inverts the gain CV

inputs.text: Audio to be measured, 1 to 16 channels, each channel getting its own detector
Moves the centre frequency of the prefilter, tracking a volt per octave with the attenuverter fully clockwise
Moves the resonance of the prefilter
Varies the gain applied to the ENV output

outputs.text: The peak amplitude of the incoming audio on that channel, scaled by GAIN
The pitch of the detected tone on that channel, 0V for C4 at 261.625Hz and one volt per octave from there; before any pitch has been detected it carries -10V
0V or 10V on that channel, high while a pitch is being detected and low otherwise, or the other way round when the menu on this port is set to gate when quiet

notes: the input port with the most channels sets the channel count of all three outputs, and any input with fewer channels repeats its last channel across the rest
menu: GATE port output mode — chooses Gate when pitch detected or Gate when quiet; it is on the panel menu and on the GATE output port's own menu
Toggle sensitivity on all attenuverters — divides the effect of every attenuverter on the panel by 10, or restores them all
Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
